news_items.headline: Pirates trade former No. 1 overall pick Davis to D-backs, sources say
news_items.summary: The Pirates are sending former No. 1 overall pick Henry Davis to Arizona in exchange for utility player Tim Tawa, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan

news_items.headline: Chisholm reaches 1-year deal with Blue Jays, sources say
news_items.summary: The Blue Jays and second baseman Jazz Chisholm Jr. are in agreement on a one-year contract with an option for a second year that guarantees him $34.5 million, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Friday.

news_items.headline: Busy Cubs, in need of rotation help, agree to terms with Japanese RHP Itoh
news_items.summary: The Cubs continued a busy month by agreeing to terms with Japanese right-hander Hiromi Itoh on Friday night, a source told ESPN on Friday, confirming a report by FanSided.

news_items.headline: Sources: Tigers stay busy, reach 1-year, $25M deal with RHP Gausman
news_items.summary: RHP Kevin Gausman and the Tigers have agreed to a one-year, $25M contract, pending a physical, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan on Wednesday.

news_items.headline: Reports: D-backs reach 1-year, $3M deal with Japanese RHP Takahashi
news_items.summary: The Diamondbacks and Japanese right-hander Kona Takahashi have agreed to a one-year, $3 million deal, according to multiple reports.

news_items.headline: Sources: Rockies adding Peterson, Sandoval to revamped staff
news_items.summary: The Rockies agreed to a two-year, $32 million deal with David Peterson and a three-year, $42 million deal with Patrick Sandoval, sources told ESPN.

news_items.headline: Reports: Guardians bring back Griffin on 3-year, $48 million deal
news_items.summary: Pitcher Foster Griffin will return to the Guardians after agreeing to a three-year, $48 million contract, according to multiple reports.
